analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported a resilient performance in Q1 FY27 with revenue growing 35% year-on-year to ₹532 crore and EBITDA increasing 36% to ₹89 crore. Despite facing a challenging operating environment due to global supply-side disruptions and elevated raw material prices, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split and expanded its product portfolio with new complex fertilizer variants. Management expressed confidence in achieving an additional 30% to 35% turnover growth over the previous year, supported by a recovery in monsoon conditions and improved capacity utilization. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its Q1 FY27 results and operational performance, highlighting strong revenue and profit growth driven by expanded capacities at Meghnagar and disciplined cost control. Management emphasized supportive macro factors including favourable monsoons, higher MSP, and government subsidies like the Nutrient-Based Subsidy framework.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover growth over the previous year.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expects growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall revenue growth of 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and continued government support are expected to support fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving in monsoon conditions, higher MSP and continued government support through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are expected to support the fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The decline in industry production was due to supply-side constraints rather than weak underlying fertilizer demand.
demand_outlook.quote: This indicates that the decline in production was primarily due to supply-side constraints, including raw material availability and logistic challenges, rather than any weakness in underlying fertilizer demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth backed by strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and government backing via the Nutrient Based Subsidy framework create a favourable operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP & continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are creating a favourable operating environment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that Kharif season demand appears constructive for the industry, supported by comfortable domestic stock levels and a favourable monsoon forecast.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure due to essential food consumption and high import shares.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.

demand_outlook.claim: Fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable despite a slightly lower monsoon forecast because reservoir water levels are higher.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating capacity expansion opportunities that have not yet been approved or disclosed.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities. Since these have not yet been approved or disclosed through the statutory channels, we are not in a position to share details at this stage.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's green ammonia capacity agreement with SECI is scheduled to start in FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that expanded capacities at Meghnagar include NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: NPK/DAP capacity was enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA alongside 120,000 MTPA of existing SSP capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: • NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Sulphuric acid capacity was strengthened to 99,000 MTPA as part of backward integration.
capex_expansion.quote: • Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under India's National Green Hydrogen Mission.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: No further capex plans beyond the implemented expansion have been planned so far.
capex_expansion.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA margin is approximately 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects EBITDA margins to remain healthy in the coming quarters.
margins_costs.quote: However, our performance in this quarter has been better than expected, and we believe EBITDA margins will remain healthy in the coming quarters as well.

margins_costs.claim: The decline in PAT margin on a quarter-on-quarter basis was largely due to a sharp rise in finance costs and depreciation from the new capacity.
margins_costs.quote: It is largely a function of the sharp rise in finance costs and depreciation following the commissioning of the new capacity.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Global input costs tightened towards the latter part of the quarter due to supply constraints and higher freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Input cost pressures and timing mismatches led to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.
margins_costs.quote: This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration has been a key contributor to EBITDA margins remaining higher than peers.
margins_costs.quote: Backward integration has been a key contributor, which is why our EBITDA margins are higher than peers.

margins_costs.claim: Margins are expected to be under pressure in the first quarter of FY27 due to rising raw material costs.
margins_costs.quote: While there may be some margin pressure in the first quarter, we expect margins to stabilize in the later part of the year as cost increases are passed on.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: The company recorded 43% capacity utilization for its NPK-DAP unit and 121% for its SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total NPK-DAP capacity reached 495,000 MT after adding 165,000 MT of capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's sales volumes stood at 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP and 36,300 MT for SSP.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: Management noted that installed capacity stands at 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
Fertilizer production for Q4 FY26 reached 94,103 MT driven by peak Rabi demand.
orders_capacity.quote: • Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Certain NPK/DAP and SSP units operated above 100% capacity during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: • Maintained healthy utilization across NPK/DAP and SSP plants, with certain units operating above 100% capacity, reflecting strong demand and efficient plant operations

orders_capacity.claim: Total annual production for FY26 reached 397,263 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: • Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

capital_allocation.claim: The company executed a 5-for-1 stock split to subdivide the face value of its equity shares from ₹10 to ₹2.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintained tight control over working capital while implementing calibrated MRP revisions.
capital_allocation.quote: We also continued to maintain tight control over working capital while implementing calibrated MRP revisions to preserve competitiveness across our core markets.

capital_allocation.claim: Credit rating has been upgraded by CRISIL to A+ (Stable).
capital_allocation.quote: We are also pleased to highlight that our credit rating has been upgraded by CRISIL to A+ (Stable), reflecting improved financial strength and business fundamentals

risks_headwinds.claim: The first quarter faced a challenging operating environment driven by global supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material prices, and geopolitical uncertainties.
risks_headwinds.quote: The 1st Quarter witnessed a challenging operating environment for the phosphatic supplier industry, primarily driven by global supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material prices, and geopolitical uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia introduced considerable uncertainty across global fertilizer supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices rose significantly from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

risks_headwinds.claim: The sequential decline in revenue from Q4 FY26 to Q1 FY27 was largely due to normal business seasonality.
risks_headwinds.quote: Accordingly, while revenue has grown on a year-on-year basis, the sequential decline from Q4 FY26 to Q1 FY27 is largely attributable to normal business seasonality.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry relies on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover growth over the previous year.
management_commitments.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: The company's green ammonia capacity agreement with SECI is scheduled to start in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the new expansion capacity is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.
management_commitments.quote: As our Managing Director mentioned, our new expansion has already commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for stakeholders.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for our stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to maintaining best utilization of manufacturing facilities for the current year.
management_commitments.quote: For the current year as well, we are committed to maintaining similar performance.
